title: Daily CS Ops Journal — QBR + Renewal Prep + Support Follow-ups
content:
Morning run-down / brain dump

Top priorities for today (order = priority):
1) AcmeCorp QBR prep (10:30 AM) — finalize slides + 15 min dry run with Maya at 9:45. Focus on: latency improvements after latest rollout, observed token-cost delta, and next-quarter roadmap ask (auto-fallback policy).
   - Data to include: last 30 days token usage (trend), 95th pct latency pre/post rollout, two customer quotes about improved tail latency.
   - Action: pull metric CSV from console (model: gpt-like-13b-quant) and embed in slide 3. TODO: request export from observability if needed (Elise).

2) Renewal at BetaFin (renewal deadline 2026-07-20) — high risk.
   - Health signals: usage down 18% MoM, 3 P1 incidents in last 45 days, billing dispute open.
   - Stake: $120k ARR.
   - Planned outreach: warm intro to Solutions Eng (Jose) + discuss Dedicated reservation discount tiers.
   - Talking points draft for email: "Quick sync on renewal + reliability plan — propose 2-week trial of Dedicated reserved capacity with SLA credits if incidents continue."
   - Ask finance for an exceptions quote (renewals@redwood).

3) Support backlog follow-ups (tickets flagged for exec mention) — triage at 11am:
   - CS-4512 (prefix cache inconsistency) — Engineering assigned; ETA unclear. Slack thread: #serving-runtime (link above).
   - CS-4630 (embedding mismatch) — Possible model mismatch; see PR #1426 in repo. Add note to escalate if no update by EOD.

Notes to self / quick checklist: 
- 8:30 — check console alerts for any overnight regressions (latency/cost spikes).
- 9:00 — send agenda to AcmeCorp attendees + dial-in link.
- 09:30 — confirm Maya is on call and slide deck is in Google Slides (v2).
- 14:00 — 30-min sync with BetaFin procurement (prep: renewal concession matrix).
- 16:00 — close loop on all follow-ups or push to tomorrow; update Jira board.

QBR talking bullets (short):
- What improved: tail latency trimmed 22% after batching optimizations; consistent throughput during peak windows.
- What we monitored: prefix/KV cache hit rate, sequence-length distribution changes, model variant fallback stats.
- What we propose next quarter: 1) pin model to 13b-quant for critical endpoints, 2) enable conservative batching window for retail pay-per-request routes, 3) monthly health check + 2x incident drills.

Renewal negotiation notes (BetaFin):
- Concessions we can offer: 10% off committed reserved capacity if commit >= $80k/month for 12 months; 30-day SLA credit window; free quarterly on-site review (remote).
- Non-starters: blanket price freeze, unlimited burst capacity without reservation.
- Strategy: present value (reliability + predictable cost) > discount. Ask for a one-quarter pilot of Dedicated + telemetry access for BetaFin infra team.

Support follow-up templates (quick copy):
- To Eng triage: "CS-4512: reproducer and logs attached. Please estimate TFT (time-to-fix) and if you need a weekend workaround. Ping me with ETA so I can inform customer."
- To customer (status): "Quick update: we have engineering working on reproducer for X; ETA for next status by EOD. Apologies for the disruption — we will propose a mitigation in the next update."

Data pulls / artifacts to attach today:
- console_export_acmecorp_30d.csv (tokens, requests, model, avg_latency_50/95) — generate before 9:15.
- incidents_summary_beta_fin.pdf — compile last 90 days (use SRE notes).

Open questions / things to ask teammates:
- Maya: can you confirm if we can show raw token usage per route in deck or do we need to redact?
- Elise: status on CS-4630 PR diff and whether we can call out exact root cause in QBR (legal concern).
- Jose (Solutions Eng): available to help run a short demo of Dedicated pilot for BetaFin next Tue?

Micro-tasks (5–15 min items):
- pull / attach recent NPS snippet for AcmeCorp (search: NPS-June-2026).
- update BetaFin renewal row in spreadsheet (column: renewal_risk = high).
- create Slack thread to notify #cs-alerts about high-risk renewal.

End-of-day wrap plan:
- send internal recap mail with actions and owners (cc: Maya, Elise, Jose).
- move unresolved items to tomorrow's top-of-day list.

Random quick notes / hot takes (brainstorm):
- Consider templated "reliability credits" clause for future renewals — standardize in legal.
- Need a short KB: "How to read the console tail-latency chart" for non-engineered PM stakeholders.

Timestamped logs (for reference):
- 07:58 — noticed small spike in AcmeCorp 95th latency (350ms -> 480ms) around 03:15 UTC; check cache invalidation logs.
- 08:12 — pinged SRE on CS-4512 reproducer.

---
Quick draft email subject lines (pick one):
- "AcmeCorp QBR — prep materials + brief agenda (30 min)"
- "BetaFin renewal — proposed pilot + reliability commitments"
- "Update on your support ticket CS-4512 — ETA and mitigation plan"

TODO tickbox (check when done):
[ ] pull AcmeCorp CSV
[ ] dry run with Maya 9:45
[ ] send BetaFin renewal concession request to finance
[ ] escalate CS-4630 if no EOD update
[ ] update Jira board with new priorities

Notes end.

(leave this file as my ephemeral daily scratchpad — will copy relevant bits into official QBR deck and renewal doc once finalized)
